title: Boho Statement Drop Earrings Pink Stone Rhinestone Floral Gold Tone Dangle
descriptionText:
Unique boho statement earrings featuring a pink cabochon center with surrounding rhinestones and petal-style accents. Gold tone setting with multicolor stones gives a floral, retro-inspired look.
Lightweight and eye-catching, perfect for festivals, casual outfits, or adding a pop of color.
Pre-owned in good condition. Please see photos for details and exact condition.
